title: Case: Merchant has received the return but the refund review has not started
context: The merchant warehouse has a receipt but the authorised refunds team has no review case. The next action is to submit that receipt to start review.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-035: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 37 irrelevant events turn this into a long thread; the decisive events are the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
